\begin{example} \end{example}[Matrices of Full Rank]

1. ch1:1.28If $m<n$, the rank-$m$ matrices in $\operatorname M(m\times n,\mathbb R)$ form an open set: at each such matrix, some $m\times m$ minor is nonzero, and remains so nearby. Hence this full-rank locus is a smooth $mn$-manifold. The analogous statement holds for rank-$n$ matrices when $n<m$. \end{example}
